_source: Single source for attestation wording shown on /terms. Must match LilyAi.Supervision.Attestations (lib/lily_ai/supervision/attestations.ex) byte-for-byte; scripts/__tests__/legal-pages.test.mjs enforces this. Statements are immutable once published: a wording change adds a _v2 key. Wording is draft, pending counsel review.

agreement_supervisor_v1.when: At countersignature of the supervision agreement
agreement_supervisor_v1.text: I attest my license is active, I meet the supervision requirements that apply to me, and I will co-sign the weekly hours log honestly.

agreement_supervisee_v1.when: At countersignature of the supervision agreement
agreement_supervisee_v1.text: I've read the supervision terms. Lily records attestations; it doesn't certify hours to the board.

weekly_signoff_v1.text: I supervised these hours as described. Lily records attestations; it does not certify hours to the board.
